summary: Keep current member access observations in master Core memory while preserving durable configuration and admission fences (BUG-0158). API impact: existing contract. Native acceptance remains open.

guide.reason: Describe awaiting new member access reports after a master management restart.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Peer access reports and master inventory retain their schemas, authentication, validation, errors and freshness rules; current observations are no longer synchronously persisted. Native access/execution gates are unchanged.

roadmap.reason: This is a correction within the current storage milestone; no acceptance gate is declared complete.

state.reason: Master Core owns configuration and reports current member observations. No Controller-owned state or new pool setting is added.
state.record: Managed storage journals and pool-storage.json retain durable repository/reservation/mutation records. Access observations are process-local, cleared on restart, and rebuilt from authenticated members. A fresh Controller adopts master inventory and current reports.

verification.method: Residual native timings show synchronous access-report file/directory flush latency. Authenticated regression, independent review and full candidate Go race suite passed. Clean fixed-build five-minute idle observation still recorded two deadline episodes (five failed samples of 150); acceptance remains open. See QA for actual results and limits.
